newsitem.title: USA: Chaparral board OKs merger offer.
newsitem.headline: Chaparral board OKs merger offer.

text.p: Chaparral Steel Co said Wednesday that its board of directors has approved an offer to merge with Texas Industries Inc.
The approval was based on the recommendation of the board-appointed Special Committee, it said.
Under the terms of the offer, holders of the publicly traded shares of Chaparral will, subject to a shareholder vote adopting the merger, receive cash consideration of $15.50 per share.
Texas Industries, which owns an 85 percent stake in Chaparral, put forth its unsolicited offer in mid-May.
Chaparral makes structural bar products from recycled steel. Texas Industries produces steel, cement, aggregates and concrete products.
